product_one_liner.value: Naïve provides infrastructure for new and existing businesses to deploy AI employees that execute workflows and operate business functions autonomously.

named_customers.notes: Naïve names these as companies where its product is deployed.

employee_band.notes: Y Combinator reports a team size of 12.

hq_location.notes: Dealroom explicitly lists San Francisco headquarters, consistent with YC’s location. Sources conflict: the August 2026 funding announcement describes Naïve as Palo Alto-based.

eng_blog.notes: The index lists one Engineering post, not the required two engineer-authored posts about how the product is built.

public_docs.notes: Public documentation includes product, SDK, model-routing and integration articles.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: Under the specified title-keyword rule, none of the six listed roles qualifies. However, the open “Founding Member of Technical Staff — RL” role has AI/ML responsibilities; its title uses RL rather than a listed keyword.

model_provider.value: OpenRouter, with access to models from Anthropic, OpenAI, Google, Meta and Mistral.
model_provider.notes: The documentation describes a wrapper over OpenRouter routing to more than 300 models.

compliance_certs.notes: The security page names none of the five specified certifications; provider attestations are available upon request.

last_funding.notes: Announced August 6, 2026; led by Nexus Venture Partners.

raised_18mo.notes: The $28.5 million Series A was announced August 6, 2026, within the requested window.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The six listed openings include no SDR, BDR, sales/business-development representative or account executive.

launched_6mo.notes: Launched Mobile Sandbox, disposable cloud phones for agents, on October 6, 2026.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: No qualifying dated appointment or departure was verified, and a complete executive roster with start dates was unavailable.

crm_stack_signal.notes: HubSpot is a public integration signal: Naïve describes CRM syncing and gated HubSpot access. This does not establish that Naïve uses HubSpot internally.
